🚨This child sex trafficking case is one important example of ICE HSI’s tireless efforts: https://t.co/4ZhRkR3PKt

💻Learn more about ICE’s HSI: https://t.co/5f6uhr4H2s

tweets.text:
BRYAN, Texas — Documented Tren de Aragua member Jesus Alberto Escalona-Mujicas no longer threatens legal residents. ICE Houston, federal partners and the Texas Department of Public Safety arrested him.

🔎The Justice Department’s Executive Office for Immigration Review ordered him removed from the United States March 6, 2024. At that point, he defied the court's removal order and went into hiding instead.

🚨We have him now and he’ll remain in our custody pending his removal.

👉Details: https://t.co/HtozNswyCn

MIAMI – ICE and its Panama Express Strike Force intercepted nearly $150M in illegal narcotics. This operation was part of our ongoing mission to stop large-scale drug trafficking, money laundering and related activities in our country by transnational criminal organizations.

They seized:
👉44,550 pounds of cocaine
👉3,880 pounds marijuana

🚨34 suspected narco-traffickers were arrested and face federal prosecution

📰Details in our newsroom.
